**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

The agreement contains no most-favoured-nation or best-pricing mechanic running in either direction:

- **§ 11 (Fees)** is a bare payment obligation: Sparkling pays per the Fee Schedule, with no benchmarking to third-party terms.
- **§ 10 (Maintenance and Support)** ties maintenance to the Fee Schedule and confirms updates/releases come "without additional fees or charges," but imposes no comparison-to-third-parties obligation.
- Targeted searches for "favo", "no less favourable", "most", "price", "lowest price", "discount" and "other customers" surfaced only unrelated hits (§ 15 risk allocation, § 16 "most current version" of source code).

Since our preferred position is simply the absence of an MFN burdening the Customer, and there is no Vendor-granted MFN that would need preserving, no edit is required.
